question: Did the tutoring program raise the share of proficient students in a class?

decision_rule.metric: difference in the percentage of proficient students, in percentage points

column_notes.pct_proficient: percent of the class scoring proficient this spring, 0 to 100
column_notes.pct_proficient_last_year: same class cohort, previous spring, 0 to 100
column_notes.pct_free_lunch: percent of students on free lunch, 0 to 100
column_notes.tutoring_program: 1 = the class had the tutoring program; poorer classes were prioritised
